messages:
sara-support: heads-up — enterprise customer (acct id red-998) flagged a 30% invoice > dashboard discrepancy for streaming usage this month. they say dashboard shows ~120k tokens but invoice charged ~160k. they only used our streaming /v1/stream endpoint and did a couple midstream reconnects. can someone take a look? :wave:

lucy-sre: can you drop the session ids + a sample request id? also curious if the client was using client.cancel() or just TCP reconnects.

sara-support: pasted the session ids in #devops-uploads, main ones: sess_7f3a, sess_7f3b. sample request id: r-2026-03-12-7f3a. customer says sequence: start stream -> few chunks -> client reconnects (network flake) -> resumes with new SSE connection -> receives final chunk.

tom-eng: thanks. preliminary theory: we historically finalize token accounting on receipt of the final "done" frame AND on explicit cancel events. with midstream reconnects we may be finalizing twice if the previous connection flushed finalization but the new connection also triggers finalization when it receives a merged final chunk. i.e., double-finalize race.

jim-billing: double count would explain invoice > dashboard. dashboard shows in-flight realtime ingest from the open session (which may only show the last finalization), invoices are reconciled from finalized events that run asynchronously and could include duplicates. need concrete repro before escalation to accounting.

lucy-sre: can infra-bot pull logs for r-2026-03-12-7f3a and the two connections around it? I'm particularly looking for lines with "FINALIZE_METER" or "EMIT_SUMMARY" and connection ids.

infra-bot: logs attached (trimmed):
```
2026-03-12T15:02:11Z r-2026-03-12-7f3a conn=conn-A STREAM_CHUNK token_count=274 partial=true
2026-03-12T15:02:18Z r-2026-03-12-7f3a conn=conn-A CLIENT_DISCONNECT reason=network
2026-03-12T15:02:19Z r-2026-03-12-7f3a FINALIZE_METER conn=conn-A tokens_finalized=274
2026-03-12T15:02:20Z r-2026-03-12-7f3a conn=conn-B STREAM_RESUME token_count=0 partial=false
2026-03-12T15:02:21Z r-2026-03-12-7f3a conn=conn-B STREAM_CHUNK token_count=86 partial=false
2026-03-12T15:02:21Z r-2026-03-12-7f3a FINALIZE_METER conn=conn-B tokens_finalized=86
```

lucy-sre: there it is — conn-A finalized 274 then conn-B finalized 86. invoice would sum both = 360 tokens. dashboard shows last known state (depends on UI aggregation) and may only reflect 86 or 274 depending on timing.

tom-eng: root cause: finalization is keyed by request id only, not connection id or generation id. when a client reconnects and the runtime merges partial then issues another finalize, the billing pipeline treats them as independent finalized events. We should make finalization idempotent at the meter/emitter layer using (request_id, generation_id) dedupe.

jim-billing: for remediation we can: 1) do a one-off invoice reconciliation for red-998 for current month (back out duplicated finalized events), 2) patch billing pipeline to de-duplicate finalized events, 3) engineering fix to emit idempotent finalize or include connection/generation id.

sara-support: customer asked for timeline and repro. tom, can you throw together a minimal repro snippet we can run to demonstrate duplication? customer can run it locally.

tom-eng: quick repro (node):
```
// simulate network flake + reconnect
const sse = connect('/v1/stream?r=r-2026-03-12-7f3a')
sse.on('data', d => { if (d.partial) process.stdout.write(d.chunk) })
// after 7s simulate disconnect, then reopen new SSE with same request id
// server may finalize on first close and then finalize again after resume
```
I'll paste a runnable script in the ticket.

lucy-sre: immediate mitigation: toggle server feature-flag meter-enforce-idempotency=false -> true? Actually we want idempotency on; check service cfg: meter_dedupe_window=15s currently disabled for streams. we can enable for the cluster serving this customer for a hotfix.

jim-billing: I'm ok doing a one-off credit if we confirm duplication. please create a billing reconciliation ticket with the finalized event ids and counts. tagging @finance for approvals.

sara-support: I'll open a support case with the repro, ask the customer to run the script and confirm. i'll also ask them for any sdk versions. they mentioned JS SDK v1.4.2.

tom-eng: next steps for eng: 1) short-term: enable meter dedupe window for streaming traffic on cluster (hotfix), 2) medium-term: change finalize events to include generation_id and make meter-ingest idempotent, 3) long-term: add server-side integration tests for reconnect + partial chunk merges to assert single finalization.

lucy-sre: pinging infra on rolling the config. if anyone wants the var name: `STREAM_METER_DEDUPE_WINDOW` (seconds). set to 30 to cover typical client reconnect TTLs.

sara-support: thanks all — i'll update the customer and file the billing ticket once we have logs + repro confirmation. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: action item created: INC-2026-1843 (enable STREAM_METER_DEDUPE_WINDOW=30 on region-us-west), assigned to lucy-sre.

tom-eng: moving to a follow-up PR after hotfix to add generation_id to finalize payloads. i'll cc billing on the change so downstream pipeline can use it.

sara-support: perfect. closing loop once finance posts credit.
